author: unknown
content:
People complained about instant fail stealth in this game, but I WISH that was in this game
It's possible some of the beginning missions were instant fail, I'm not sure as I didn't experience that.  However, I am trying to do one of the quests related to the keycards.  I have good standing with the Pyke syndicate, but I have to enter a restricted area in one of their compounds.  I'm finding it pretty much impossible to stealth through.  If this were instant fail, that would be fine, but it's similar to recent Far Cry or Assassin's Creed games where enemies spawn endlessly.  Once you are spotted, it is impossible to progress in the mission so you have to reload a save.  Deactivating the alarm doesn't matter, full armies still rush to the area (they just don't telepathically know where you are, which doesn't matter when you are in a 'search area' and don't know exactly where you need to go).

What is really frustrating is I am trashing reputation when I am spotted as well, so I don't have a choice but to reset unless I want to lose OTHER progress as well.

Anyway, I would like instant fail stealth missions, or alternately I would like the ability to disable the alarm, clear the room, and no more enemies would appear so I could explore the fantastic and detailed world the devs created.  But no, I am forced to save scum.  Is there something I can do to reset aggro/stealth in this game that I'm just not seeing?
